name: 08035 · Haddon Hgts, NJ
findings: ZIP 08035 (Haddon Hgts) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08035 (Haddon Hgts) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08035 (Haddon Hgts) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
